name: Dumbbell row
instructions: Rest one knee and one hand on the bench, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to your hip.
Lower it back down with control.
cue: Pull the elbow past your hip
mistakes: Twisting the torso to pull the weight up.
Letting the shoulder shrug instead of the elbow driving back.
